import sqlite3, shutil, os, tempfile

paths = [
    os.path.join(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"], r"Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\History"),
    os.path.join(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"], r"Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\History"),
]
for h in paths:
    print("PATH", h, "exists", os.path.exists(h))
    if not os.path.exists(h):
        continue
    tmp = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), f"hist_{os.getpid()}.db")
    shutil.copy2(h, tmp)
    c = sqlite3.connect(tmp)
    q = (
        "SELECT datetime(last_visit_time/1000000-11644473600,'unixepoch','localtime'), url "
        "FROM urls WHERE url LIKE '%refract%' OR url LIKE '%8080/%' OR url LIKE '%8081/%' "
        "OR url LIKE '%CONFIGURATOR%' OR url LIKE '%spline.design%' OR url LIKE '%vercel.app%' "
        "ORDER BY last_visit_time DESC LIMIT 60"
    )
